author: Inside Edition
description: Prince Harry, wife Meghan Markle and their two children are setting up house at their new home in the English countryside. One person who was happy to see them depart the United States for the United Kingdom is President Trump. The chief executive didn't mince words regarding his feelings for the Sussexes, telling reporters he thought Meghan and Harry "treated the royal family with great disrespect."
title: Trump Happy That Meghan and Harry Have Left The US

author: Inside Edition
description: America woke up to the news that feminist icon Gloria Steinem had died at age 92. Steinem led the women's movement in the 1970s. She helped found the legendary Ms. magazine, and campaigned tirelessly for the rights of women. But what you may not know is that Steinem was a pop culture phenom, as well, appearing in several movies and TV shows. Inside Edition's Brooke Anderson has more on Steinem's remarkable life and career.
title: Feminist Icon Gloria Steinem Dies At 92

author: Inside Edition
description: The jurors in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial were back at it today for their sixth day of deliberations. If they end up deadlocked again, and a mistrial is declared, Lindsay's lawyer Kevin Reddington says 'bring it on.' Her team is ready to start the trial all over again. If convicted of murder, Clancy faces life in prison. Inside Edition's Alison Hall is at the courthouse in Plymouth, Massachusetts.
title: What Happens If The Lindsay Clancy Jurors Remain Deadlocked?

author: Inside Edition
description: A group of good Samaritans joined forces to lift a Volkswagen, after an e-bike collided with it, pinning the rider underneath. The incredible rescue in Prospect Park, Pennsylvania was caught on surveillance camera. Thankfully, their efforts paid off. The victim's daughter says her mom suffered multiple broken ribs, a shoulder injury and a collapsed lung, but that she will never forget the strangers who stopped to help. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian is at the scene.
title: Good Samaritans Band Together To Lift VW Off E-Bike Rider

author: Inside Edition
description: All eyes have been on the jurors in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial, as the panelists do their civic duty in a case that has gripped the nation. Now comes a warning about a jury duty scam, in which some people across the country are losing thousands of dollars to unscrupulous scammers. The Justice Department says a court will never ask for a credit card number or banking information, and it will never demand payment over the phone. Inside Edition's Jim Moret tells us how the scam works.
title: What Is The 'Jury Duty Scam' And How Can You Protect Yourself From It?

author: Inside Edition
description: Police in New Hampshire are cautioning residents after a series of violent animal attacks from unknown creatures. So far three attacks have occurred in Lebanon, New Hampshire, with the most recent caught on camera near a U-Haul vehicle. The animal has been described by witnesses as either a gray fox or a fisher cat, and has reportedly displayed unusually aggressive behavior toward people. Police urge that residents and visitors do not approach, attempt to capture, feed, or otherwise interact with the animal.
title: What Is This Vicious Animal In Caught On Camera Attack?

author: Inside Edition
description: These officers in California stopped mid-bite to make an arrest. Monrovia Police released video of the lunchtime takedown in a Panda Express. The man was reportedly wanted on a parole violation and happened to stop into the restaurant, unaware of the two officers setting their sights on him. Witnesses were also caught off guard by the midday action. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cops On Lunch Break At Panda Express Arrest Wanted Man Who Happened To Come In
